name: Balneological Heap Analysis

VINIT.justification: the state of the heap before a specific pharmacy address index is applied

TANCH.justification: the final state where the vessel is confirmed to hold the instruction depth

AFWD.justification: the directed transformation of placing pharmacy opcodes into the heap heap folio

AREV.justification: the removal of instructions or residue to return the heap to a clean state

CLINK.justification: the mapping of the pharmacy folio number to the folio heap via modulo 20

IMSCRIB.justification: the recognition that the selected folio corresponds to its own structural capacity

FSPLIT.justification: partitioning the vessel into its maximum instruction split-capacity and closure-ratio branches

FFUSE.justification: recombining the capacity and closure branches to reconstruct the unitary vessel definition

EVALT.justification: the state where the vessel capacity exceeds the required opcode count

EVALF.justification: the state where the vessel is too shallow to contain the instructions

ENGAGR.justification: the state where the vessel is simultaneously containing and transforming a cold extract

IFIX.justification: the permanent entry in the session log that Gate 2 has passed or failed

phase_3.true_description: valid vessel with sufficient split capacity and closure ratio
phase_3.false_description: bottleneck condition where instruction count exceeds vessel capacity
phase_3.both_description: volatile preparations held in semi-closed vessels where closure ratio is non-binary

steps.domain_action: access the total set of twenty balneological folios
resolve the pharmacy folio index against the heap using modulo arithmetic
identify the specific physical vessel folio retrieved from the heap
map the operation count from the pharmaceutical address to the vessel capacity
bifurcate the vessel analysis into capacity verification and closure evaluation
verify that the vessel split capacity is greater than or equal to the instruction count
detect if the instruction depth overflows the available vessel slots
evaluate the closure ratio for the specific solvent and temperature protocol
hold the state for non-volatile preparations requiring strict heat containment
merge the closure verification back into the capacity branch
reunite the validated parameters into a single confirmed vessel state
record the successful Gate 2 pass in the session append-only log
seal the balneological vessel and transition to the astronomical winding

phase_5.memory_mechanism: balneological section f75–f84 register and FSPLIT tables
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Gate 2 execution sequence following Gate 1 success
phase_5.alfs_store: LSI_ivtff_0d.txt transcription of the Balneological section

phase_6.cycle_cost: one modulo computation and two logical comparisons
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: selected pharmacy address with unknown vessel compatibility
phase_6.post_cycle_state: validated heap vessel ready for instruction streaming
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the gate verifies structural capacities without altering the underlying manuscript data
